parameters.schedule: shuffle all eligible (algorithm,operator,query) blocks per repetition; fixed seed
parameters.generator: exact fixed membership recipes; 100 tokens/doc; all query/filler tokens four ASCII characters; seeded filler and position shuffle; uppercase + punctuation

timer: time.perf_counter_ns; integer elapsed_ns per complete block
background_load: ordinary desktop background load; project tests and LaTeX build paused during timing; not isolated
cache: prepared corpus and prechecked index reused; no cold-cache measurement; load includes OS cache effects

timing_boundaries.load: complete public load_corpus on fixed disk files
timing_boundaries.preparation: complete public prepare_corpus on already loaded raw documents
timing_boundaries.build: complete public build_inverted_index on prepared documents
timing_boundaries.query: complete public search including query normalization, posting gathering, stable length sort if applicable, merging, full fresh result list
timing_boundaries.block: five complete identical calls retained then checked; loop/list-of-results overhead included equally; previous results deleted before next timer
timing_boundaries.excluded: generation, correctness, diagnostics, disk output, summary and plotting; no memory instrumentation

statistics: median, inclusive Q1/Q3, IQR; one block is one sample; quartiles are not confidence intervals
memory: not measured in topic03; CSV index_bytes and peak_memory_bytes remain empty

source_fixture.corpus_selection: existing single eight-paragraph document unchanged; no new paragraph segmentation
